caption: The drawing depicts a single chair positioned in the center of the composition, viewed from the front. The chair has a dark wooden frame, with an intricately carved Gothic-style back featuring pointed arches and ornamental cutouts. The seat is upholstered in a muted, light-colored fabric with horizontal striations and a small, circular stain on the front edge. The chair's legs are slightly curved and taper down to small feet, with subtle carved details at the top of the front legs. The background is a plain, light beige color with small scattered spots and a thin rectangular border drawn around the perimeter of the image. In the lower right corner, the artist's signature, "Josef Rotenberg," is visible.
title: Side Chair
